sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Red Zirconia Tulip Gold Clavicle Chain
sourceNotes.rawContent: Add a romantic touch to your jewelry collection with this elegant red tulip pendant necklace. Featuring a deep ruby-colored synthetic zirconia bud and sparkling crystal leaves on a gold-finished chain, this niche design offers a sophisticated, versatile look. Perfect for daily wear, this dainty clavicle chain adds a bold, feminine accent to any outfit
